title: 第五章 以身立阵
slug: 穿越戍边我从炮灰辅卒一路封王
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

狂风暴雪卷着细碎冰渣，狠狠砸在斑驳的堡墙之上，发出噼里啪啦的脆响。

漫天白茫茫的雪原尽头，那面漆黑狼头王旗高高悬立，在凛冽风雪中肆意舒展。

黑羯王旗一出，整片雪原的风仿佛都冷了数分。

堡墙上所有残卒，手上的动作齐齐停滞，呼吸瞬间凝滞。

常年驻守北疆的边军，没人不知道这面旗帜的含义。那是黑羯最高统帅的象征，只有羯族王室亲征，才会亮出这面狼头大旗。

之前对上的羯族精锐，只是敌方用来诱敌的弃子。真正的杀局核心，是这位亲临前线的黑羯王，以及他麾下隐藏的千余铁骑。

“是羯王……居然是羯王亲至北疆小堡……”

刘屯将盯着远方天际，嗓音干涩沙哑，握着长刀的手掌控制不住发抖，眼底布满了绝望。

他守堡五年，见过无数次羯族袭扰，可从来没遇过羯王亲自带队围剿一座破败戍堡。

用一国藩王的主力大军，围杀二十几个残兵，这份阵仗荒唐到极致，也凶狠到极致。

周疤子停下修补墙体的动作，抬头望着远处那道狰狞王旗，脸上最后一丝侥幸彻底消失。

他混迹边关半生，太清楚羯王的手段。此人嗜杀成性，所过之处从无活口，北疆无数村镇尽数毁在他手里。今日黑石堡撞上对方亲征，等同于彻底陷入死路。

堡内的气氛跌至谷底，刚刚稳住军心的残卒们，再度被无边的恐惧笼罩。

有人手脚发软，死死靠着墙体才能站稳，眼底满是等死的颓然。

没人说话，风雪呼啸间，只剩众人沉重粗重的喘息声。

苏烬依旧立在最高的墙垛之上，血色染透了半边衣襟，断裂的肋骨每动一下，都牵扯着五脏六腑传来钻心的疼。

可他的脊背始终挺得笔直，目光死死锁定远方缓缓逼近的羯族大军。

狼头王旗之下，密密麻麻的黑色铁骑从雪原暗处涌出，黑压压一片铺满大地，战马铁蹄碾过积雪，发出沉闷厚重的轰鸣，一步步压缩着所有人生存的空间。

上千铁骑列阵而行，甲胄寒光连片，弯刀出鞘的寒芒映着白雪，杀气横贯千里雪原。

这才是黑羯真正的主力。

之前墙头血战的数十精锐，和眼前这支大军相比，连蝼蚁都算不上。

“苏兄弟，完了，彻底完了。”陈石头脸色惨白如纸，声音带着抑制不住的颤抖，“这么多羯兵，还有羯王亲自来，咱们这座破堡根本挡不住，援军也快掉进圈套里了……”

其余士卒纷纷低头，眼底皆是绝望。

有的人已经悄悄放下了手里的兵刃，放弃了抵抗。

以二十余残兵对上千骑精锐，悬殊的差距足以碾碎所有人的抵抗意志。

周疤子深吸一口寒风，转头看向身形单薄却稳如磐石的苏烬，沉声道：“苏烬，事到如今，没必要硬撑了。羯王亲征，必死无疑，咱们趁着大雪掩护，弃堡从后山小道逃，或许还能活几个。”

这话戳中了所有人的心思，不少残卒立刻抬头，眼里亮起一丝求生的微光。

绝境之中，放弃死守、伺机逃窜，是他们唯一能想到的活路。

苏烬闻声，缓缓转过头。

他的脸上没有丝毫慌乱，只有历经沙场的冷静与冷冽。那双漆黑的眸子扫过众人动摇的脸庞，没有半分怜悯。

Page (1/3)

The violent wind and snow rolled up fine ice shards and smashed hard on the mottled fortress wall, making a crackling sound.

At the end of the vast white snowfield, the pitch-black Wolf-Headed King Flag hangs high, unfurling in the biting wind and snow.

As soon as the Black Capricorn King's flag came out, the wind in the entire snowfield seemed to have become a bit colder.

All the remaining soldiers on the fort wall stopped moving their hands, and their breathing froze for a moment.

Everyone among the border troops stationed in northern Xinjiang all year round knows the meaning of this flag.That is the symbol of the supreme commander of Black Jie. Only the Jie clan royal family will display this wolf-headed flag.

The elites of the Jie clan that they faced before were just abandoned sons used by the enemy to lure them.The real core of the killing was the Black Capricorn King who came to the front line and the more than a thousand hidden cavalry under his command.

"It's King Jie...it's actually King Jie who came to the small fort in northern Xinjiang..."

General Liu Tun stared at the distant sky, his voice was dry and hoarse, the palm of his hand holding the long knife couldn't help shaking, and his eyes were full of despair.

He had been guarding the fort for five years and had seen countless attacks by the Jie clan, but he had never encountered King Jie personally leading a team to encircle and suppress a dilapidated fort.

Using the main army of a vassal king to surround and kill more than twenty remaining soldiers, this battle was extremely absurd and extremely cruel.

Zhou Scarzi stopped repairing the wall, looked up at the ferocious king's flag in the distance, and the last trace of luck completely disappeared from his face.

He has been living in border areas for half his life and is very aware of King Jie's methods.This man was murderous, and there was never a living person wherever he went. Countless villages and towns in northern Xinjiang were destroyed in his hands.Today, Blackstone Castle collided with the opponent's personal expedition, which was equivalent to a complete dead end.

The atmosphere in the fort fell to the bottom, and the remaining soldiers who had just stabilized their morale were once again enveloped in boundless fear.

Some people's hands and feet were so weak that they had to rely on the wall to stand firm, and their eyes were full of dejection as they waited for death.

No one spoke, and amid the howling wind and snow, there was only the heavy and heavy breathing of everyone.

Su Jin was still standing on the highest wall, half of his clothes stained with blood, and every move of his broken ribs caused heartbreaking pain in his internal organs.

But his back was always straight, and his eyes were fixed on the slowly approaching Jie clan army in the distance.

Under the Wolf Head King's flag, densely packed black cavalry emerged from the darkness of the snowfield, covering the ground in blackness. The iron hooves of the war horses crushed the snow, making a dull and thick roar, gradually compressing everyone's living space.

Thousands of cavalry were marching in formation, their armors shining with cold light, the cold light of their unsheathed scimitars reflected the white snow, and their murderous aura spread across thousands of miles of snowy fields.

This is the true main force of Black Capricorn.

The dozens of elites who had fought bloody battles on the wall before were not even ants compared to the army in front of them.

"Brother Su, it's over, it's over." Chen Shitou's face was as pale as paper, and his voice was trembling uncontrollably. "With so many Jie soldiers, and King Jie coming in person, our ruined fortress can't stop it at all, and the reinforcements are about to fall into the trap..."

The other soldiers lowered their heads one after another, with despair in their eyes.

Some people have quietly put down their weapons and given up resistance.

With more than 20 remnant soldiers facing thousands of elite cavalry, the huge gap is enough to crush everyone's will to resist.

Zhou Scarzi took a deep breath of the cold wind, turned to look at Su Jin, who was thin but as stable as a rock, and said in a deep voice: "Su Jin, now that things have happened, there is no need to hold on. King Jie will definitely die if he goes to the army himself. Let's take advantage of the heavy snow cover, abandon the fort and escape through the back mountain trail, maybe we can still survive."

These words touched everyone's minds, and many of the disabled soldiers immediately raised their heads, with a glimmer of survival in their eyes.

In a desperate situation, giving up their defense and waiting for an opportunity to escape is the only way they can think of to survive.

Su Jin heard the sound and slowly turned his head.

There was no trace of panic on his face, only the calmness and coldness of someone who had experienced the battlefield.Those dark eyes swept across everyone's shaken faces, showing no mercy.
